description:
kith-peer defines its own PeerDeliveryError (crates/kith-peer/src/lib.rs line 679) with variants: InsecureUrl, Timeout, Network, HttpError, PeerRejected, InvalidResponse.

This error type has no From<PeerDeliveryError> for KithError (defined in kith-core), so delivery errors cannot propagate through the standard ? operator into functions that return KithError. The outbox_tick function handles PeerDeliveryError locally and never surfaces it to KithError callers, meaning any cross-boundary propagation requires manual matching.

By contrast, all other subsystem errors (storage, auth) ultimately convert to KithError via From impls. PeerDeliveryError stands alone.

Fix: add impl From<PeerDeliveryError> for KithError in kith-core (or kith-peer via a KithError::Delivery variant), making peer delivery errors first-class members of the shared error hierarchy. This enables ? propagation and uniform error logging at the boundary.
title: PeerDeliveryError in kith-peer has no conversion path to KithError, creating an error-type island
